cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline cyclone-resilient agricultural decision support for smallholder farmers in Mauritius and other cyclone-exposed African and Indian Ocean communities.

test_prompts.prompt: A cyclone warning has been issued and heavy rain is expected within 24 hours. I have six-week-old tomatoes in a slow-draining open field, limited labour, stakes, plastic sheets, and compost. Give me a prioritized preparation plan with safety limits.

After a cyclone, my vegetable field is waterlogged, some leaves are scorched, and a fallen power line is visible near the access path. Explain what I should do first, what I should not do, and how to assess crop recovery once authorities say it is safe.
